title: https://www.sleep-clinic.ca/
description: The Sleep Disorders Clinic offers a full range of diagnostic and therapeutic sleep services, including night time sleep studies and daytime tests. Our 3 locations contain private bedrooms and we perform sleep studies 7 nights a week. Most services are covered by OHIP and all new patients require a referral from their family doctor or specialist. Sleep studies are offered in Hamilton, St Catharines and Cambridge Memorial Hospital.
